messages:
maya: heads-up 12 PR #4128 updates the tiny-starter quickstart to use the newer auth helper. need a quick eyes on the deploy section + token example before merge.

devin: on it. noticed snippets use SDKv8-style calls but the sample repo still pins v7. either we update the repo to v8 or make snippets backward compatible.

lee: CI error reproduces locally. deploy script expects DEPLOY_TARGET env var. running `./scripts/deploy.sh` gives `Error: missing DEPLOY_TARGET`.

ci-bot: [build/4128] failed 12 unit-tests (examples) failed on example-deploy.sh (exit 1). details: https://ci.redwood.run/build/4128

ashley: prefer keeping quickstarts minimal. if upgrading repo to sdk8 is heavy, show both variants in the snippet and a tiny note. less friction for copy-paste. :+1:

sam: i can draft a tiny change: show modern `Redwood.client()` plus a comment `// v7: use RedwoodLegacy.init()` so older pins still follow.

maya: great. also the deploy link in the doc points to /docs/deploy-old (404). should be /docs/deploy/serverless instead.

devin: formatting nit: a fenced block labeled `bash` contains a JS import line, which highlights wrong. i'll split into separate fenced blocks for shell and JS.

lee: local patch tested. added DEPLOY_TARGET fallback and updated README snippet. snippet from deploy.sh i added: ```sh
if [ -z \"$DEPLOY_TARGET\" ]; then
  DEPLOY_TARGET=serverless
fi
./deploy --target "$DEPLOY_TARGET"
```

sam: opening PR with combined fixes (snippets dual variant, link to /docs/deploy/serverless, deploy fallback, split fences). will paste PR link here.

ci-bot: [pull/4139] checks started 12 examples, lint, docs-links.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4139 12 includes: dual snippets (v7/v8 note), link fix, deploy.sh fallback, separate fenced blocks. tested locally.

devin: quick review in progress. one small request: add a changelog line under docs/update-log.md so release notes pick it up.

docs-bot: reminder: update quickstarts index if the example filename changed (quickstarts/index.yml).

maya: assigning reviewers devin + lee. if approved today i'll merge and publish site refresh tomorrow morning. thanks all!
